models_evaluated: Sanchez-Pinto and Khemani early AKI score (recalibrated logistic regression)

links.outcome: Discrimination of single-center AKI model on multicenter temporally split test data
links.effect: Recalibrated single-center model AUROC fell to 0.78 (PEDSNET-VPS) and 0.65 (PDC) versus 0.86 originally; PDC-trained model cross-validated in PEDSNET-VPS had AUROC 0.62.
links.quote: After recalibration in the training split, the AUROC in the PEDSNET-VPS dataset was 0.78 [95% CI, 0.78–0.78] and in PDC was 0.65 [95% CI, 0.64–0.65].

links.outcome: Performance of single-center model when applied to different multicenter populations and data
links.effect: Single-center model AUROC was 0.74 in PEDSNET-VPS and 0.39 in PDC with original coefficients; two of seven features were unavailable in PDC.
links.quote: The AUROC was 0.74 in the PEDSNET-VPS dataset and 0.39 in the PDC dataset, which is missing two of the seven features as previously described.

links.outcome: Discrimination and PPV after recalibrating/extending single-center model with local data
links.effect: Recalibration alone left poor discrimination (AUROC 0.65-0.78; AUPRC 0.10-0.12); adding features gave AUROC 0.80-0.88 and AUPRC 0.13-0.22, though PPV remained low (10-12% at 90th percentile).
links.quote: After the addition of new features that would be available at the time of the prediction, we found improved discrimination and performance.

links.outcome: Model performance generalization to new populations and sites
links.effect: Single-center model performance decreased on multicenter data; PDC model applied to PEDSNET-VPS had lower sensitivity and PPV at both cutpoints (AUROC 0.62, AUPRC 0.03).
links.quote: Sanchez-Pinto and Khemani ( 5 ) created a parsimonious score to predict early AKI from single-center data; when we applied this score across multicenter data, the performance decreased.

links.outcome: Alert burden (PPV and number needed to alert) at chosen cutpoints
links.effect: At 90th percentile cutpoint PPV was 10% (PEDSNET-VPS) and 12% (PDC), with NNA 11 and 9; false alerts remain high.
links.quote: Future work includes user-focused decision support design based on model results, guided by the need to minimize alert burden given our PPV and NNA results, to improve the actionability and usability of this predictive model ( 48 ).

unlisted_practices: Excluding race and ethnicity as predictors a priori to avoid exacerbating systemic bias
